entryGate.reasoning: Mario Kart World is a Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive title (June 5, 2025), with no release on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, or original Switch. Nintendo Switch 2 has no system-wide achievement/trophy system (Nintendo of America VP Bill Trinen confirmed this directly). No native achievement list exists anywhere for this game.

modes: Knockout Tour (12 rallies as of v1.8.0, grown from 8 at launch)
keyFacts.grandPrix: 7 base cups + hidden Special Cup (unlocked via gold/1st overall in all 7). Special Cup contains Rainbow Road (otherwise unavailable) and triggers the game's ending/credits on completion.
keyFacts.engineClasses: 50cc, 100cc, 150cc, and Mirror Mode. No 200cc exists as of v1.8.0.
keyFacts.mirrorModeUnlock: Compound requirement (converging across scouts): 3rd place/clear or better in all Grand Prix cups (incl. Special Cup) and all Knockout Tour rallies at 150cc, plus 10 P-Switch missions + 10 Peach Medallions + 10 ?-Panels in Free Roam, then replay the Special Cup. This is treated as the game's true 'hardest difficulty' unlock.
keyFacts.roster: 50 racers (32 default + 7 via Grand Prix cup clears + 11 via permanent Kamek mid-race transformation unlocks tied to specific courses).
keyFacts.vehicles: 40 vehicles (21 karts/11 bikes/6 trikes/2 mobiles), unlocked via coin thresholds (~every 100 coins, all unlocked at ~3,000 lifetime coins). No swappable parts — customization is via a 1,056-sticker system instead.
keyFacts.freeRoamCollectibles: 394 P-Switches (short timed missions), 200 Peach Medallions, 150 ?-Panels (across 29 of 30 courses). Post-1.2.0 patch, the Free Roam map shows per-category discovery and marks a category complete.
keyFacts.costumes: Unlocked via 'Dash Food' at Yoshi's Diners in Free Roam. Total count conflicts: 103 vs 127 across sources.
keyFacts.stickerMilestones: 225 of the 1,056 stickers are awarded for crossing lifetime-stat thresholds (coins, distance driven, glide distance, tricks, races) — confirms the game internally tracks these stats and surfaces a notification on threshold crossing, even though no dedicated 'stats screen' was confirmed.
keyFacts.battleMode: 8 courses, 3 game types: Balloon Battle, Coin Runners, Bob-omb Blast (added via update 1.6.0).
keyFacts.bosses: None found — consistent with the racing genre and every prior Mario Kart entry.
keyFacts.onlineSystem: VR (Versus Rating) starting at 3000, tracked separately per online mode (Race/Knockout Tour/Battle/Friends). Servers confirmed operational as of Sept 2026.
keyFacts.missables: None found — all collectibles and unlocks appear permanently available via Free Roam replay at any time.
keyFacts.dlc: No paid DLC as of Sept 2026. Two free content updates (July 2026, Sept 9 2026) added Knockout Tour rallies, 10 classic SNES courses as standalone VS Race selections, Spectator Mode, and Photo Mode stickers.
keyFacts.hiddenContent: Easter egg: driving into the stained-glass Peach window atop Peach Stadium unlocks a mirrored version of the Free Roam world (Super Mario 64 reference).

conflicts: Total unique Grand Prix courses: 29 vs 30 (some courses like Peach Stadium and Crown City appear twice under different cups with remixed layouts).
Costume/outfit total count: 103 (unlockable only) vs 127 (including defaults).

Exact Mirror Mode unlock wording: 'gold/1st in all 7 base cups' (Special Cup prerequisite) vs '3rd place or better across all 8 cups + all Knockout Tour rallies' (Mirror Mode's own checklist) — likely two distinct, compatible gates rather than a contradiction, but not confirmed end-to-end from one authoritative source.
gaps: No confirmed dedicated lifetime stats/profile screen (total races, win rate, distance) beyond the 225 threshold-crossing sticker notifications — cumulative trophies should rely on the sticker-notification confirmation, not an assumed stats screen.
Knockout Tour rally count is a live-service moving target (8 at launch → 12 as of v1.8.0, Sept 2026) — a 'clear every rally' trophy should be scoped/noted as pinned to this patch.
Exact star-rank grading criteria (what earns 1 vs 2 vs 3 stars) not fully sourced.
No official item-probability table for RNG-relevant items (Kamek, Coin Shell, Blue Shell).
